email_subject: Application - Customer Care Hero at Bolt
email_body:
Hi Bolt team,

What stands out for me in your Customer Care Hero role is that the person on the phone is the voice of Bolt itself. I have spent years being exactly that kind of first point of contact: as a tango instructor in Türkiye I ran a studio's daily operations, worked with people every day, built trust and took ownership from the first class of the day to closing. That is where I learned that a satisfied customer makes your day.

Today I work in digital marketing, where I answer client questions, run discovery meetings and follow up on every issue until it is resolved. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. The energy transition is the part that pulls me in: buying directly from local green producers is a concrete way to make the Belgian grid more sustainable.

I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem. In my first weeks I would learn your CRM and invoice and contract flows inside out, so I can answer customers quickly and personally. I would like to talk.

# Baver Ok
Customer-focused · Dutch B1/A2+ · Tango instructor · Problem-solver

English (fluent) · Turkish (native) · Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+)

## SUMMARY
I want to be the voice of Bolt for energy customers, helping them by phone and email with invoices, contracts and moving house. My years as a tango instructor taught me to work with people every day, build trust and take ownership of a whole studio, from the first class of the day to closing. I am analytical, I follow processes closely, and I am eager to learn. I speak Dutch at B1/A2+ and fluent English. I want to contribute to the energy transition and make every customer interaction personal and positive.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present
- **#4 on page 1** of Google Turkey for "PDKS" (access-control software), as part of the agency team
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present
- Sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services, with a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026
- Delivered client websites end to end, from site structure and content to social media integration
- Analysed SEO performance and reported results to clients with Search Console and Google Analytics

### Tango Instructor – Türkiye, 2015 – 2018

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

## SKILLS
- **Growth & sales:** client discovery meetings, offers and proposals, lead generation, landing pages, A/B testing
- **SEO & marketing:** SEO strategy, keyword research, content marketing, on-page, technical, local and mobile SEO, link building, SEO audits, schema markup, AI search (GEO/AEO), Google Ads Search, WooCommerce
